blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Federation of Free Farmers (FFF) on Wednesday urged Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu-Laurel, Jr. to show “delicadeza” and take a leave of absence amid the investigation into the alleged illegal importation of P395 million worth of rice. “Out of a sense of delicadeza, Secretary Francisco P. Tiu-Laurel, Jr. should take a leave of absence as Department of Agriculture (DA) Secretary,” the FFF said in a statement. The group’s appeal relates to the Bureau of Customs’ investigation into the seizure of 312,000 bags of Vietnamese rice from Planters Products, Inc. (PPI), where Laurel holds 79 percent of the […]...
